title: krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
why_read: A handy, well-scoped utility for showing wireless peripheral battery levels on Windows without installing bulky vendor software, but technically modest.
analysis: This is a lightweight Windows tray application that reads battery status from wireless mice, keyboards, headsets, and controllers across many vendors like Logitech, Razer, and Microsoft/Sony controllers, displaying it directly in the taskbar. The main technical interest is in how it communicates with proprietary HID/Bluetooth battery reporting protocols across so many different vendors without needing their official software. It's a solid quality-of-life tool rather than something pushing new technical boundaries. Useful for end users, but unlikely to teach experienced engineers much that is new.
